subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar e reproduzir, em relatórios de observação e pesquisa, a formatação e diagramação específica desses gêneros (passos ou listas de itens, tabelas, ilustrações, gráficos, resumo dos resultados), inclusive em suas versões orais.

components.description_pt: Identificar recursos de formatação específicos dos gêneros relatório de observação e pesquisa
components.description_en: Identify formatting features specific to observation and research report genres
components.cc_component_description: Interpret complex text structures and features common to science and technical genres

components.description_pt: Reproduzir elementos de layout de relatórios de pesquisa, incluindo etapas, tabelas, gráficos e ilustrações
components.description_en: Reproduce layout elements of research reports, including steps, tables, graphs, and illustrations
components.cc_component_description: Integrate textual descriptions with visual formats such as diagrams, graphs, or tables

components.description_pt: Reconhecer como elementos de layout específicos do gênero são adaptados em versões orais de relatórios
components.description_en: Recognize how genre-specific layout elements are adapted in oral versions of reports
components.cc_component_description: Contrast the techniques used in written and performed versions of a story, drama, or poem

components.description_pt: Distinguir a organização estrutural de relatórios de observação de outros gêneros informativos
components.description_en: Distinguish the structural organization of observation reports from other informational genres
components.cc_component_description: Contrast the structural techniques used across different literary forms to address the same topic

cc_matches.description: Integrate quantitative or technical information expressed in words in a text with a version of that information expressed visually (e.g., in a flowchart, diagram, model, graph, or table).
By the end of grade 12, read and comprehend science/technical texts in the grades 11—CCR text complexity band independently and proficiently.

Compare and contrast the experience of reading a story, drama, or poem to listening to or viewing an audio, video, or live version of the text, including contrasting what they "see" and "hear" when reading the text to what they perceive when they listen or watch.
Compare and contrast texts in different forms or genres (e.g., stories and poems; historical novels and fantasy stories) in terms of their approaches to similar themes and topics.
